mapper.sql: CASE WHEN o.order_status IN ('manual_rejected','timeout_rejected','user_cancelled','cancelled') THEN 'cancelled' WHEN c.closed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'return_closed' WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'return_checking' WHEN s.shipment_status='sent' THEN 'return_in_transit' WHEN r.check_status IN ('confirmed','auto_confirmed') THEN IF(o.current_due_date<DATE(#{at}),'overdue','renting') WHEN r.id IS NOT NULL THEN IF(#{at}<r.start_at,'pending_receipt','receipt_checking') WHEN o.order_status='accepted' THEN 'pending_outbound' ELSE 'not_started' END

SELECT o.id order_ref, fulfillment_stage, CASE WHEN ex.factory_deadline_at>#{at} THEN ex.factory_deadline_at WHEN c.closed_at IS NOT NULL THEN NULL WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN IF(c.check_status='pending' AND #{at}<c.warning_at,c.warning_at,c.auto_close_at) WHEN s.shipment_status='sent' THEN s.expected_check_start_at WHEN r.check_status IN ('confirmed','auto_confirmed') AND o.current_due_date>=DATE(#{at}) THEN DATE_ADD(o.current_due_date,INTERVAL 1 DAY) WHEN r.check_status='pending' THEN IF(#{at}<r.start_at,r.start_at,r.deadline_at) WHEN o.order_status='pending_accept' THEN o.accept_deadline_at END next_deadline_at, COALESCE(c.check_start_at,s.sent_at,r.confirmed_at,o.accepted_at,o.created_at) actionable_since, c.claim_created active_claim,r.confirmed_at received_at FROM rental_order o LEFT JOIN order_extension_request ex ON ex.active_order_guard=o.id AND ex.extension_status IN ('pending_factory','factory_warning') LEFT JOIN order_return_check c ON c.rental_order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN order_return_shipment s ON s.rental_order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN order_receipt_check r ON r.rental_order_id=o.id

EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_claim cl JOIN inventory_reservation hold ON hold.rental_order_id=cl.rental_order_id AND hold.reservation_status='disputed_holding' WHERE cl.rental_order_id=${orderRef} AND cl.claim_status='executing' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arbitration_case a WHERE a.claim_id=cl.id AND a.case_status!='closed') AND (hold.quantity>(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.quantity),0) FROM order_claim_stock_result f WHERE f.claim_id=cl.id AND f.original_reservation_id=hold.id AND f.result_status IN ('recorded','repair_pending')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_claim_stock_result f WHERE f.claim_id=cl.id AND f.original_reservation_id=hold.id AND f.result_status='repair_pending')))

EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_claim cl WHERE cl.rental_order_id=rental_order.id AND cl.claim_status='supplement_required') OR OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arbitration_case a JOIN admin_case_relation rel ON rel.relation_type='arbitration_case' AND rel.relation_id=a.id AND rel.is_primary=1 WHERE a.rental_order_id=rental_order.id AND a.case_status='waiting_evidence' AND (SELECT k.request_payload_json->>'$.party' FROM admin_case_action k WHERE k.admin_case_id=rel.admin_case_id AND k.action_type='requestArbitrationEvidence' ORDER BY k.created_at DESC,k.id DESC LIMIT 1)='factory') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_case_action ac WHERE ac.target_type='rental_order' AND ac.target_id=rental_order.id AND ac.action_type='resolve_order_issue' AND ac.action_status='executing' AND ac.operator_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND ac.request_payload_json->>'$.fulfillment_decision'='terminate' AND f.fulfillment_stage IN ('return_in_transit','return_checking') AND COALESCE(f.active_claim,0)=0)

(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_issue_report i WHERE i.rental_order_id=rental_order.id AND i.issue_status NOT IN ('resolved','closed')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_claim cl WHERE cl.rental_order_id=rental_order.id AND cl.claim_status NOT IN ('draft','closed','withdrawn','rejected') AND cl.user_response_deadline_at IS NOT NULL) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arbitration_case ac WHERE ac.rental_order_id=rental_order.id AND ac.case_status NOT IN ('closed','cancelled')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_compensation_receivable ar WHERE ar.rental_order_id=rental_order.id AND ar.receivable_status IN ('pending','paying')))

WHERE 1=1
AND buyer_user_id=#{query.buyerId}
AND factory_id=#{query.factoryId}
AND (LOCATE(#{query.keyword}, CONVERT(order_no USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin)>0 OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM rental_order_item i WHERE i.rental_order_id=rental_order.id AND LOCATE(#{query.keyword}, i.prop_name_snapshot)>0))
AND rental_start_date>=#{query.startDate}
AND rental_end_date<=#{query.endDate}
AND order_status='pending_accept'
AND order_status='accepted'

AND (order_status='pending_accept' AND accept_deadline_at>#{at} OR ((f.fulfillment_stage='pending_outbound' OR (f.received_at IS NOT NULL AND f.fulfillment_stage IN ('renting','overdue','return_in_transit','return_checking') AND COALESCE(f.active_claim,0)=0)) AND rental_order.id NOT IN #{id}) OR ())
AND order_status='completed' AND f.fulfillment_stage IN ('pending_receipt','receipt_checking')
AND f.fulfillment_stage=#{query.view} AND order_status<>'completed'

ORDER BY (f.next_deadline_at IS NULL), f.next_deadline_at,f.actionable_since,id ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{query.page.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.page.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*)=2 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name IN ('factory_settlement_detail','factory_settlement_batch')

SELECT o.id order_id,(SELECT MIN(i.factory_name_snapshot) FROM checkout_batch_item_snapshot i WHERE i.checkout_batch_id=o.checkout_batch_id AND i.factory_id=o.factory_id) factory_name, d.delivery_status,f.fulfillment_stage,f.next_deadline_at,l.service_mode return_mode, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_transport_leg expense_leg WHERE expense_leg.rental_order_id=o.id AND expense_leg.charge_mode='freight_pool') expense_required, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM factory_settlement_detail sd JOIN factory_settlement_batch sb ON sb.id=sd.settlement_batch_id WHERE sd.rental_order_id=o.id AND sb.settlement_status='settled')FALSE settled_batch, (SELECT issue_scene FROM order_issue_report i WHERE i.rental_order_id=o.id AND i.fulfillment_effect='paused' AND i.issue_status IN ('submitted','processing','waiting_evidence') ORDER BY i.reported_at DESC,i.id DESC LIMIT 1) paused_issue_scene, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM admin_case_action a WHERE a.target_id=o.id AND a.target_type='rental_order' AND a.action_type='resolve_order_issue' AND a.parent_action_id IS NULL AND a.operator_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND a.action_status IN ('executing','failed','succeeded') AND a.request_payload_json->>'$.fulfillment_decision'='terminate') THEN CASE WHEN NOT () OR () THEN 'terminated' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_return_check rc WHERE rc.rental_order_id=o.id) THEN 'return_checking' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_return_shipment rs WHERE rs.rental_order_id=o.id AND rs.sent_at IS NOT NULL) THEN 'return_in_transit' ELSE 'termination_pending' END END termination_display_status, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_issue_report i WHERE i.rental_order_id=o.id) issue_exists, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_extension_request ex WHERE ex.rental_order_id=o.id) extension_exists, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_extension_request ex WHERE ex.rental_order_id=o.id AND ex.submitted_to_factory_at IS NOT NULL) factory_extension_exists, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_extension_request ex WHERE ex.active_order_guard=o.id) pending_extension, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_claim cl WHERE cl.rental_order_id=o.id) claim_exists, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_claim cl WHERE cl.rental_order_id=o.id AND cl.user_response_deadline_at IS NOT NULL) buyer_claim_exists, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_claim cl WHERE cl.rental_order_id=o.id AND cl.claim_status NOT IN ('draft','closed','withdrawn','rejected')) claim_active, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_claim cl WHERE cl.rental_order_id=o.id AND cl.user_response_deadline_at IS NOT NULL AND cl.claim_status NOT IN ('draft','closed','withdrawn','rejected')) buyer_claim_active, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arbitration_case a WHERE a.rental_order_id=o.id) arbitration_exists, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arbitration_case a WHERE a.rental_order_id=o.id AND a.case_status NOT IN ('closed','cancelled')) arbitration_active, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_compensation_receivable ar WHERE ar.rental_order_id=o.id) debt_exists, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_return_check rc WHERE rc.rental_order_id=o.id AND rc.claim_created=0 AND rc.closed_at IS NULL AND rc.check_start_at<=#{at} AND rc.auto_close_at>#{at}) claim_window, claim_stock_work FROM rental_order o JOIN () f ON f.order_ref=o.id JOIN rental_order_delivery d ON d.rental_order_id=o.id JOIN order_transport_leg l ON l.rental_order_id=o.id AND l.leg_type='return' WHERE o.id IN #{id}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(order_status='pending_accept'), 0) pending_accept_count, COALESCE(SUM(order_status='accepted'), 0) accepted_count, COALESCE(SUM(refund_status='failed'), 0) refund_exception_count, COUNT(*) all_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(f.fulfillment_stage='pending_outbound'),0) pending_outbound_count, COALESCE(SUM(f.fulfillment_stage='return_checking'),0) return_checking_count, COALESCE(SUM(),0) exception_order_count FROM rental_order WHERE factory_id=#{id}
